name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.4-dev.1 (21 Nov): helicopter range stat, match results fixed (winner sent 5 s before time-up, draws, Major/Minor), infantry AT launchers aim AT rounds in 0.2 s, tank-hunter teams 15 shots a minute, 105 mm reloads, China infantry armour 8, QN-506 and HJ-10 rework, smoke stops Fire at position, Blue Dragon spec (testing preview). Includes everything in 0.9.3. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.48.
